# PaymentsSovereignty.com

> PaymentsSovereignty.com — independent, descriptive .com domain for payments sovereignty: strategic autonomy, governance and resilience of payment infrastructures, schemes, rails and wallets in the digital age. Neutral banner for observatories, frameworks and research hubs.

No affiliation with the European Union, the Eurosystem, ECB, national central banks, supervisors, governments, international organisations, payment schemes, payment institutions, electronic money institutions, banks, fintechs or private companies. Descriptive use only. No legal, financial, medical, regulatory or investment advice. No technical or payment advice. Descriptive digital asset only: no service, no platform, no certification. Domain name only is transferred. No software, datasets, services or staff included.
